definition: Bottlenose.com, also known as Bottlenose, is an enterprise trend intelligence company that analyzes big data and business data to detect trends for brands.
details: It helps Fortune 500 enterprises discover, and track emerging trends that affect their brands. The company uses natural language processing, sentiment analysis, statistical algorithms, data mining, and machine learning heuristics to determine trends, and has a search engine that gathers information from social networks. KPMG Capital has invested a "substantial amount" in the company. Bottlenose processed 72 billion messages per day, in real-time, from across social and broadcast media, as of December 2014.

explainer.lead: Bottlenose is a company that helps large brands spot emerging trends in enormous streams of business and media data. Its service is designed to turn fast-moving public conversation into signals that enterprises can discover and track.

tiers.eli5: Imagine trying to hear every conversation in a huge stadium and work out what people are starting to talk about. Bottlenose builds tools that do something similar with online and broadcast messages, helping big companies notice new topics that could affect their brands.
tiers.practitioner: Bottlenose applies natural language processing, sentiment analysis, statistical algorithms, data mining, and machine-learning heuristics to social and broadcast media streams. Its search engine gathers social-network information, and the resulting trend signals are used for brand discovery and tracking. High message throughput does not by itself establish trend-detection accuracy, and sentiment or correlation should not be treated as proof of business impact.
tiers.paperLevel: Operationally, the system maps a real-time message stream M to brand-relevant trend signals T using language, sentiment, statistical, data-mining, and machine-learning methods. Its reported scale was 72 billion messages per day in December 2014. That figure describes processing volume, not precision, recall, latency, or the validity of individual detected trends.

explainer.example: A Fortune 500 brand could use Bottlenose to gather social-network messages about its market, analyze their language and sentiment, and then discover and follow an emerging conversation that may affect the brand.
